findings.title: AC3 checked at the view seam, not S1; norn trace parity not newly asserted
findings.detail:
Plan coverage row: 'B3 | S1 | integration | timelines through the view's timeline read and `norn trace` equal the old entries'. The test calls loadTimelines directly in view.test.ts; `norn trace` is unchanged code (loadTraceView) and covered by its existing tests, so the risk is low.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: an S1 check that `norn trace <unit> --json` and loadTimelines agree on one unit.

findings.title: orient is in the slice goal but not in the trace-free test
findings.detail:
Slice Goal: '`norn cockpit`, `status`, `status --segment`, `inbox` and `orient` stop reading the trace'. orient goes through projectView, so it is trace-free by construction, but no test observes it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add `orient: () => h.norn("orient", "gh-7", "--json")` to the views table.

findings.title: TRACE_WINDOW_MS (14 days) is defined locally
findings.detail:
The 14-day timeline window is the one tidy's retain floor (B25) must not undercut; a local constant in one file makes that link easy to miss when slice for tidy lands.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Export one named window constant when B25 needs it.
